7 انْسِرَاحٌ The act of running, or going along [quickly and easily]. (KL.) You say of a she-camel, اِنْسَرَحَتْ فِى سَيْرِهَا She was, or became, quick and easy in her pace. (A.) ―
-b2- And انسرح He lay upon his back, or lay as though thrown down or extended, and parted his legs. (S.) ―
-b3- And He was, or became, naked, bare, or without clothing. (KL. [See also its part. n., مُنْسَرِحٌ.]) ―
-b4- And It (grief or sorrow) became removed, or cleared away; [syn. اِنْفَرَجَ;] as also ↓ تسرّح ; quasi-pass. of سَرَّحَ signifying فَرَّجَ. (L, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
